sn40.4:1.4: Idha bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa-domanassānam atthagamā ca adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhā-sati-pārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.4:1.6: So khvāham āvuso sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa-domanassānam atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhā-sati-parisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.4:1.7: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato sukhasahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn40.4:2.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn40.4:2.3: mā brāhmana catutthaṃ jhānam pamādo catutthe jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi catutthe jhāne cittam ekodikarohi catutthe jhāne cittaṃ samādahāti || || 7
sn40.4:2.4: So kho ahaṃ aparena samayena sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa-domanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkham asukham upekkhā-satipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.4:2.5: Yaṃ hi tam āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya || pe || mahābhiññatam pattoti || || 3
